questions.question_text: What is Artificial Intelligence (AI) primarily used for, as discussed in the chapter?

options.text: Designing colorful websites for businesses
Teaching computers to think and make decisions like humans using data
Printing large amounts of data on paper
Creating physical robots for household choresCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: Which of the following is an example of Machine Learning (ML) as explained in the chapter?

options.text: Writing a school essay using a word processor
A spam filter learning to identify junk emails based on patterns in data
Drawing a chart by hand for a project
Playing a video game without saving progressCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: What is a key difference between a Data Analyst and a Data Scientist, according to the chapter?

options.text: Data Analysts predict future trends, while Data Scientists explain current data
Data Analysts explain what’s happening with data, while Data Scientists build models to predict the future
Data Analysts focus on building hardware, while Data Scientists focus on software
Data Analysts only work in schools, while Data Scientists work in hospitalsCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: Which high school subject is most helpful for preparing for a career in data and analytics?

options.text: Physical Education, to stay active while working
Math, to understand patterns and statistics
Art, to design better-looking charts
History, to learn about past data trendsCorrect Answer:B

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a free resource mentioned in the chapter for learning data skills?

options.text: A paid subscription to a data magazine
Khan Academy, for lessons on statistics and coding
A private tutor for advanced data science
Buying expensive data software for personal useCorrect Answer:B
